messages.subject: reactively load shiny app
parts:
Is there a way to have a shiny app reactively/dynamically load a whole new shiny app(or website)?

For instance let's say I had a few shiny apps each built for an individual.  I would love to have another shiny app that lets them type in their username in an text input box, if the username matches their shiny app loads.

Seems like the only missing piece is some reactive function that loads/launches a url/website/shiny app.  Would browseUrl() work?
